events.event: Golkar chair and Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia denied involvement in the alleged illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo, called a claim that he met the arrested generals before their arrest invented, and gave the accuser 3x24 hours to prove it or face a somasi and legal action.
events.key_numbers: 3x24 hours ultimatum · claimed meeting 3 hours before the generals' arrest (disputed by Bahlil) · statement at DPD Golkar Maluku inauguration, 7 Nov 12:02 WIB
events.why_it_matters: The wiretapping case now reaches a sitting minister and party chair, who says it is an attack on Golkar.
events.spreading_evidence: detikNews top of /berita feed, 3 related headlines on 7 Nov

events.event: State Intelligence Agency (BIN) head Herindra was summoned to the palace by Prabowo and called the alleged wiretapping illegal and leading toward subversion; Mensesneg Prasetyo Hadi urged a transparent probe and said the palace will keep cleaning house.
events.key_numbers: BIN head Herindra at Istana, Fri 6 Nov · 4 suspects (Listyo Sigit, Ahrie Sonta Nasution, Eko Hadi Santoso, Slamet Uliandi)
events.why_it_matters: Intelligence and palace framing escalates the case from a police matter to a state-security matter.

events.event: DPR Deputy Speaker Sufmi Dasco Ahmad said the House could speed up the Surveillance Bill (RUU Penyadapan), already on the 2026 priority list, to be discussed after the current recess.
events.key_numbers: DPR recess ends 9 Nov 2026 · RUU Penyadapan on 2026 Prolegnas priority list
events.why_it_matters: A law on when authorities may tap phones would affect everyone's privacy, and DPR resumes sitting 9 Nov.

events.event: TNI found the black box of the Mi-17V5 helicopter that crashed in Seruyan waters, Central Kalimantan, during a karhutla water-bombing mission, and began investigating the cause; three soldiers died and five crew are to be treated in Jakarta and Semarang.
events.key_numbers: 3 TNI soldiers killed · 5 crew to be treated in DKI and Semarang · 8 crew aboard (earlier report E0622)
events.why_it_matters: Fighting the fires is costing soldiers' lives, and the cause of the crash is now under investigation.

events.event: PDI-P secretary-general Hasto and the youth group PB Pemuda Muslimin Indonesia urged DPR to start the process of removing Vice President Gibran over the diploma case, while Dasco said DPR is still in recess and has not received the full Supreme Court (MA) ruling.
events.key_numbers: DPR recess 9 Oct-9 Nov 2026 · calls made 7 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Pressure to remove the Vice President is building as DPR returns from recess.

events.event: The Constitutional Court Honorary Council (MKMK) rejected a report alleging ethics violations by the nine constitutional judges in the Gibran diploma case, finding no violation.
events.why_it_matters: It closes the ethics route against the judges who handled the Vice President's diploma suit.

events.event: UGM issued a statement responding to former President Jokowi showing his diploma at the Roy Suryo defamation trial, saying it respects the legal process.
events.key_numbers: Jokowi testified 5 Nov as prosecution witness · UGM statement 6-7 Nov · next hearing involving dr Tifa 12 Nov
events.why_it_matters: The university that issued the diploma has now commented on the most-watched diploma dispute.

events.event: KPK seized Rp 2 billion returned by KAI president director Bobby Rasyidin in the Pertamina gas-station (SPBU) digitalisation corruption case, and is tracing where the money came from; Bobby publicly responded.
events.why_it_matters: A state-company boss is linked to a Pertamina digitalisation graft probe.

events.event: The government said the Pidie, Aceh shooting case is handed to Komnas HAM and no joint fact-finding team (TGPF) will be formed.
events.why_it_matters: Decides who investigates a shooting in Aceh and how independent that probe is.
